name: dde_example
summary: This EA is a DDE (Dynamic Data Exchange) example that demonstrates how to exchange data between MetaTrader 5 and external applications via the DDE protocol. It does not implement any trading strategy but serves as a technical utility for inter-process communication. The EA likely publishes or subscribes to market data and account information through DDE topics.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个DDE（动态数据交换）示例，演示了如何在MetaTrader 5与外部应用程序之间通过DDE协议进行数据交换。它不实现任何交易策略，而是作为进程间通信的技术工具。该EA可能通过DDE主题发布或订阅市场数据和账户信息。
strategy_analysis: 此EA不包含任何交易策略，它是一个DDE通信工具。DDE（动态数据交换）是Windows平台上一种进程间通信机制，允许MT5与外部程序（如Excel）实时共享数据。该EA的核心功能是建立DDE连接，将MT5中的行情数据、账户信息等通过DDE话题（Topic）暴露给外部应用程序。它不涉及任何入场条件、出场条件或仓位管理逻辑。资金管理方面也没有相关实现，因为该EA纯粹是数据传输工具。风险方面，由于不执行交易，因此不存在交易风险，但DDE连接本身的稳定性需要注意。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not contain any trading strategy; it is a DDE communication utility. DDE (Dynamic Data Exchange) is an inter-process communication mechanism on the Windows platform that allows MT5 to share data in real-time with external programs such as Excel. The core functionality of this EA is to establish DDE connections and expose MT5 market data, account information, and other data through DDE topics to external applications. It does not involve any entry conditions, exit conditions, or position sizing logic whatsoever. There is no money management implementation since the EA is purely a data transmission tool. In terms of risk, since it does not execute trades, there is no trading risk, but the stability of the DDE connection itself should be noted.

parameters.name: DDE_Topic
parameters.description: DDE话题名称，用于标识数据交换通道
parameters.description_en: DDE topic name for data exchange channel

parameters.name: UpdateInterval
parameters.description_en: DDE data update interval in milliseconds

parameters.name: EnableDDE
parameters.description: 是否启用DDE数据交换功能

pros: 实现了MT5与外部应用程序的实时数据交互能力
作为示例代码有助于开发者理解DDE通信机制
可用于将MT5数据导入Excel等工具进行自定义分析
不执行交易操作，无交易风险
pros_en: Enables real-time data interaction between MT5 and external applications
Serves as useful example code for developers to understand DDE communication mechanism
Can be used to import MT5 data into Excel or other tools for custom analysis
Does not execute trading operations, eliminating trading risk
cons: DDE是较老旧的技术，微软已不推荐使用，存在兼容性风险
DDE连接不稳定，容易出现数据丢失或连接中断的问题
仅支持Windows平台，跨平台兼容性差
缺乏错误处理和重连机制，通信中断后无法自动恢复
作为示例代码功能有限，实际应用需要大量扩展
cons_en: DDE is an outdated technology no longer recommended by Microsoft, posing compatibility risks
DDE connections are unstable and prone to data loss or connection interruptions
Only supports Windows platform with poor cross-platform compatibility
Lacks error handling and reconnection mechanism; cannot auto-recover after communication interruption
As example code, functionality is limited and requires significant extension for practical use
improvements: 建议改用更现代的通信方式，如WebSocket、ZeroMQ或命名管道替代DDE
增加连接状态监控和自动重连机制，提高通信可靠性
添加数据校验和异常处理逻辑，防止数据传输错误
improvements_en: Recommend replacing DDE with more modern communication methods such as WebSocket, ZeroMQ, or named pipes
Add connection status monitoring and automatic reconnection mechanism to improve communication reliability
Implement data validation and exception handling logic to prevent data transmission errors

risk_points: DDE连接不稳定可能导致外部程序接收到过时或不完整的数据
缺乏连接断开时的通知机制，用户可能不知晓数据已停止更新
risk_points_en: Unstable DDE connections may cause external programs to receive stale or incomplete data
Lack of notification mechanism when connection drops; users may be unaware data has stopped updating

summary_en: This EA is a DDE (Dynamic Data Exchange) example that demonstrates how to exchange data between MetaTrader 5 and external applications via the DDE protocol. It does not implement any trading strategy but serves as a technical utility for inter-process communication. The EA likely publishes or subscribes to market data and account information through DDE topics.
